## Overview

Enable fp8 kv cache for GLM5.3 Flash by default

## Test

```bash
vllm serve zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash \
    --trust-remote-code \
    -tp 4 \
    --load-format fastsafetensors \
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.88 \
    --enable-prefix-caching \
    --host 0.0.0.0 \
    --port 9256 \
    --max-model-len auto \
    --max-num-seqs 48 \
    --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":5}'
```

### Acc

`lm_eval --model local-completions --model_args "base_url=http://127.0.0.1:9256/v1/completions,model=$MODEL,num_concurrent=1024" --tasks gsm8k --trust_remote_code`

```bash
|Tasks|Version|     Filter     |n-shot|  Metric   |   |Value |   |Stderr|
|-----|------:|----------------|-----:|-----------|---|-----:|---|-----:|
|gsm8k|      3|flexible-extract|     5|exact_match|↑  |0.9295|±  |0.0071|
|     |       |strict-match    |     5|exact_match|↑  |0.9287|±  |0.0071|
```

### Perf

```bash
vllm bench serve --model $MODEL  --dataset-name random --host 127.0.0.1 --port 9256 --random-input-len 2 --random-output-len 1024 --max-concurrency 1 --num-prompts 32 --num-warmups 4 --trust-remote-code --temperature 0  --ignore-eos  --seed 256
```

files.patch:
@@ -70,6 +70,32 @@ def verify_and_update_config(vllm_config: "VllmConfig") -> None:
         )
 
 
+class Glm5NextModelConfig(VerifyAndUpdateConfig):
+    @staticmethod
+    def verify_and_update_config(vllm_config: "VllmConfig") -> None:
+        from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+        cache_config = vllm_config.cache_config
+        if (
+            cache_config.cache_dtype != "auto"
+            or not current_platform.is_cuda()
+            or not current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100)
+            or getattr(vllm_config.model_config.hf_text_config, "index_topk", None)
+            is None
+        ):
+            return
+
+        cache_config.cache_dtype = "fp8"
+        logger.info_once("Using fp8 KV cache for GLM-5.3-Flash")
+        spec_config = vllm_config.speculative_config
+        if (
+            spec_config is not None
+            and spec_config.method != "mtp"
+            and spec_config.kv_cache_dtype is None
+        ):
+            spec_config.kv_cache_dtype = "auto"
+
+
 class Ernie4_5_VLMoeForConditionalGenerationConfig(VerifyAndUpdateConfig):
     @staticmethod
     def verify_and_update_config(vllm_config: "VllmConfig") -> None:

     "Gemma4ForCausalLM": Gemma4Config,

     "Gemma4UnifiedForConditionalGeneration": Gemma4Config,

+    "Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration": Glm5NextModelConfig,
     "GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM": GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM,
